mainEntity.name: What is the best roofing material for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asphalt shingles (affordable, 20-30 years), metal (50+ years, energy-efficient), tile/clay (50+ years, fire-resistant), or slate (75+ years, premium). Depends on climate, style, budget, and HOA rules.
